inputs.original_text: The owner of Blue Waters has said that Government collects taxes from them “without doing or investing in anything”.Perhaps this might be considered as an environmental tax. Plastic bottles can be found everywhere, blocking rivers and drains, which then enter...
inputs.modified_text: The Blue Waters owner’s complaint about taxes misses the point: when plastic waste clogs rivers and drains, ordinary communities—especially those with the fewest resources—pay the price. Businesses shouldn’t get to keep the profits while shifting pollution’s costs onto everyone else. Producers need to be held accountable, and public investment is part of protecting people and the places they live.
